name: Zabbix
short_description: Enterprise-class open source distributed monitoring solution.
description: Zabbix is a mature, enterprise-level platform for monitoring the health and performance of your entire IT infrastructure. It collects metrics from servers, virtual machines, network devices, and applications in real time. It features advanced alerting, customizable dashboards, and auto-discovery of devices. This self-hosted stack includes the central Zabbix Server, a web frontend (Nginx), a PostgreSQL database, and a local Zabbix Agent to monitor the server itself.
usecases: Monitor CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics for all your homelab servers.
Set up alerting to notify you via email or webhook when a service goes down.
Build custom dashboards to visualize the health of your entire network.
Monitor IoT devices, routers, and switches using SNMP.
notes: The default login for the Web UI is Admin / zabbix (case-sensitive). Please change it after first login.
Port 10051 is exposed so external Zabbix Agents can report metrics to the server.
